standard-dialogue-after-monkey-madness-i.npc: My squad and I are to remain on this island in secret. The monkeys think we are trying to break our friends out of the jail, but we are just biding our time.

standard-dialogue-after-monkey-madness-i.player: What are you still doing here?

standard-dialogue-after-monkey-madness-i.npc: I'm hunting for maniacal monkeys that escaped Glough's airship laboratory!
Not yet, I'm still perfecting my strategy... I'll let you know as soon as I find a way.
